newsitem.title: USA: Senator sounds caution on USTR nominee Barshefsky.
newsitem.headline: Senator sounds caution on USTR nominee Barshefsky.

text.p: Senate Republican Leader Trent Lott sounded a caution Tuesday on the nomination of Charlene Barshefsky to be U.S. Trade Representative.
Lott told a news conference he was concerned about the "perception that we're not complying with the law" that bars the USTR post to people who have represented foreign governments in trade issues.
Barshefsky, as a private lawyer, has represented Canadian lumber interests.
Lott said there were "some good reasons for having that law on the books" and it would not be waived lightly.
At the same time Lott warmly praised Barshefsky as a tough negotiator, adding "I would like to see her confirmed."
He said he had made no decision on the nomination and would continue to work through the legal issue.
